The cart tests are in `tests/cart.test.ts`. Pass that file to Node's test runner directly:

```sh
node --test tests/cart.test.ts
```

Don't use `npm test -- tests/cart.test.ts` for this. The `test` script already includes the `tests/*.test.ts` glob, so npm would add your file to that list and every test would still run.

This works because Node 22.18+ (the version `package.json` requires) runs `.ts` files natively.

To run only some tests inside the cart file, filter by test name:

```sh
node --test --test-name-pattern="total" tests/cart.test.ts
```
